<thought>Based on the pairwise resistance measurements, the network can be represented with four resistors arranged as a series chain from B to X1 (B‑Nb2‑Nb1‑X1) and a single branch from B to the intermediate node Nb3. The resistor values that reproduce the measured resistances are:
- R1 = 35 Ω between B and Nb2
- R2 = 10 Ω between Nb2 and Nb1
- R3 = 5 Ω between Nb1 and X1
- R4 = 20 Ω between B and Nb3 (Nb3 is connected to X1 through the series path B‑Nb2‑Nb1‑X1, giving the measured Nb3‑X1 resistance of 30 Ω)

This topology matches all the provided measurements when the effective resistances are calculated.

The required JSON description is:</thought>
<final_answer>{"resistors":{"R1":35,"R2":10,"R3":5,"R4":20},"connections":[["B","Nb2","R1"],["Nb2","Nb1","R2"],["Nb1","X1","R3"],["B","Nb3","R4"]]}</final_answer>
